title: 第二十七章请帖
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
“王猛，你知道我这次来，请帖是明面上的事，主要还是为了大爷的事情。”

    他放慢语调：“大爷要的女子凑齐了吗？我来之前，大爷可是特意嘱托我来问问这件事。”

    张守安一笑：“自然凑齐了，大爷尽管放心好了。”

    鼠妖满意地点点头：“你的眼光，大爷自然是放心的。”

    “就像前几天送上来的那个女修，两位爷是喜欢的不得了。”

    但他突然语气一变：“但就是你这检查，两位爷都不满意。”

    “本来送上去那晚，两位爷就想行鱼水之欢，结成连理的，这原本是一件美事啊。”

    “可都怪你，你把那女修送上来前，为什么不好好检查一下。”

    “那女子身上有道禁制，两位爷刚想碰她，就全被震开，经脉受伤不轻。”

    “后来两位爷一查，才明白。”

    “只有与他在吉日成婚，行三拜九叩礼数的男子，才能与她有夫妻之实。”

    “不然那道禁制，就会一直伤害强暴者。”

    “但因为新郎只能有一个。两位爷都看上了这个女子。”

    “所以，两位爷因为你的疏忽，彼此间打了一架，伤害了兄弟间的感情。”

    他一拍桌子，怒气更加：“王猛。你要知道，没有我们二熊山，你什么都不是！”

    “什么荡妖队，那都是我们二熊山愿意留着，你们现在才能存在，你却如此疏忽，是真的活够了。”

    张守安赶紧道歉：“是是是，都是我的错，您消消气，消消气，我保证，这几天就找到一个姿色不输那人的女子，献给两位爷，缓和他们间的感情。”

    鼠妖听见这话，也是缓了缓，而后夸赞道：“不错，就因为你这觉悟，两位爷才把这么重要的任务交给你办，你可不能辜负他们的期待。”

    “是是是，我有今天，全仰仗两位大爷”……他奉承一波，开始打听起了情报。

    “使者大人，咱们这次宴席都请了哪些贵宾？我也好提前准备点见面礼，别到时候失了礼数。”

    鼠妖顺顺胡子，久久没有说话，意思自然也是表达清楚了。

    张守安一笑：“自然也有大人的。”

    鼠妖当即笑笑：“既然你有这份心，那我也不好推脱。”

    “来的人物可是不少——青狼岭灰风大王麾下的狼先锋、蟒王潭佘娘子的义妹佘青青、还有黑风山黑风老祖手下的虎冲，再加上各路英雄好汉。”

    他瞅了眼张守安：“这次来的，可都是各家的心腹，你的礼数自然要备好一些。”

    张守安心里默默记下几只妖的名字，然后就听鼠妖继续说道：

    “至于你给我的礼数”他露出手腕，在张守安面前晃了一眼：“我这胳膊上啊，最近缺个玉镯子装饰。”
content_en:
"Wang Meng, you know that when I came this time, the invitation was only for the sake of publicity. It was mainly for the uncle's business."

    He slowed down his tone and said, "Have you got all the girls you want? Before I came, I specifically asked me to ask about this matter."

    Zhang Shou'an smiled: "Of course we've got it together, don't worry, sir."

    The rat demon nodded with satisfaction: "I am naturally reassured by your vision."

    "Just like the female cultivator I sent you a few days ago, you two are very fond of it."

    But his tone suddenly changed: "But even with your inspection, neither of you is satisfied."

    "Originally, the two men wanted to have sex and get married on the night they were sent there. This was originally a beautiful thing."

    "But it's all your fault. Why didn't you check the female cultivator carefully before sending her here?"

    "That woman had a restriction on her body. Just when the two men tried to touch her, they were all shaken away, and her meridians were seriously injured."

    "The two masters later found out after checking it out."

    "Only a man who marries her on an auspicious day and performs three bows and nine kowtows can become husband and wife with her."

    "Otherwise, that restriction will always harm the rapist."

    "But because there can only be one groom. Both men are attracted to this woman."

    "So, the two masters had a fight with each other because of your negligence, which hurt the feelings between brothers."

    He slapped the table and became even more angry: "Wang Meng. You have to know that without our Erxiong Mountain, you are nothing!"

    "What a demon team, we at Erxiong Mountain are willing to keep it. You can only exist now, but you are so negligent. You have really had enough."

    Zhang Shou'an quickly apologized: "Yes, yes, it's all my fault. Calm down, calm down. I promise that in the next few days, I will find a woman who is as beautiful as that man and dedicate it to the two masters to ease the relationship between them."

    When the rat demon heard this, he also calmed down, and then praised: "Yes, it's because of your awareness that the two masters entrusted you with such an important task. You can't live up to their expectations."

    "Yes, yes, I owe everything to these two uncles for what I am today"... He flattered and began to inquire about information.

    "Sir Envoy, who are the distinguished guests we have invited to this banquet? I'd better prepare some greeting gifts in advance so that we don't lose etiquette when the time comes."

    The rat demon smoothed his beard and didn't speak for a long time, so his meaning was naturally expressed clearly.

    Zhang Shouan smiled: "Of course there are adults too."

    The rat demon immediately smiled: "Since you have this intention, then I can't shirk it."

    "There are quite a few people here - the Wolf Pioneer under King Hui Feng of Qinglang Ridge, She Qingqing, the adopted sister of Madam She from Python King Tan, and Hu Chong under the Black Wind Ancestor of Black Wind Mountain, plus all kinds of heroes."

    He glanced at Zhang Shou'an: "The people here this time are all confidants of each family, so naturally you should be more prepared with etiquette."

    Zhang Shou'an silently wrote down the names of several demons, and then listened to the rat demon continue:

    "As for the courtesy you gave me?" He exposed his wrist and waved it in front of Zhang Shou'an: "I'm missing a jade bracelet on my arm recently."
